title: 第13章 老子第14章 无为
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
却说昭关城外百里之遥，有一片荒山野岭，名唤枯骨岭。山中本有虎豹豺狼，毒蛇猛禽，倒也算得山野之间常景。
这日，怪事来了。
但见那山道尽头，慢悠悠行来一头青牛，牛背上端坐一位老者。
那老者鹤发如瀑，白眉垂至颊边，面容古朴，一身灰布道袍洗得发白，手中无鞭无缰，双手拢在袖里，随着牛背一颠一颠，好似个瞌睡的老农。
本也无甚稀奇。
可那青牛走着走着，忽然张开嘴，
“牛妹妹坐船头哇~~牛哥哥我岸上走哟~~”
一声嘹亮的歌嗓炸开！
真个是石破天惊！那声音又粗又哑，好似铜锣刮铁锅，又似驴叫配锯木，调子忽高忽低，东拐西歪，荒腔走板到了极致。
更要命的是，这家伙还带颤音，每一个字尾都拖出一条弯弯绕绕的尾巴，能把人的耳朵拧成麻花。
歌声所过之处，路边野草齐齐伏倒，枝头鸟雀扑棱棱炸窝而飞，树叶簌簌而落。
山道旁，一只吊睛白额大虫正伏在岩石上晒太阳。那歌声传来，大虫浑身一抖，虎躯猛颤，两只前爪死死捂住耳朵，龇牙咧嘴，发出一声痛苦的呜咽，翻身滚下岩石，连滚带爬钻进灌木丛中。
不远处三只野狼正在啃骨头，闻声齐齐仰头，冲天嚎了一声，丢下骨头，夹着尾巴狂奔而去，那模样比见了猎人还慌。
青牛浑然不觉，越唱越来劲，脑袋一摇一晃，尾巴甩得像拨浪鼓：
“恩恩爱爱——纤绳荡悠悠哇——”
砰！
一拳砸在牛脑门上！
老者眼皮都没抬，收回拳头拢入袖中，也不言语。
青牛脑门上鼓起一个核桃大的包，疼得直哆嗦，四条腿一软差点跪下。它委屈巴巴地回过头，两只牛眼汪汪含泪，瓮声瓮气道：
“老爷！你又打我！”

“不专心赶路，该打。”
“那老爷你倒是交代个去处啊！”青牛把嘴一撇，鼻孔喷出两道白气，“自打离了兜率宫，你老人家东走走西逛逛，也不说上哪儿，也不说干什么，我这四条腿又不是铁打的！闲着无聊唱个曲儿怎的了？”
老者缓缓睁开双目。
那一双眼，浑浊之中透着无尽深邃，好似藏着日月星辰、天地万象。他抬手捋了捋垂至胸口的白须，目光望向远方苍茫山峦，声音如暮鼓晨钟：
“那你知是何缘故吗？”
青牛道：“不知。”
老者叹道：“此春秋末世，诸侯并起，干戈不休，杀机之重，亘古罕见。天地之间阴阳二气失调，浊气横行，煞气冲霄。我观这方天地，再过百年便是战国，届时七雄逐鹿，白骨露于野，千里无鸡鸣。若无人化解，这一场刀兵之劫，不知要死多少生灵。”
青牛的耳朵竖了起来。
老者从袖中缓缓取出两卷竹简，竹简古朴无华，上面的字迹却隐隐透出一丝金光。
“我手中有捭阖二道，欲传于世人。捭者，开也；阖者，闭也。以此二术纵横天下，或可引导诸侯息兵止戈，化解这浩劫于无形。”
青牛似懂非懂，点了点硕大的牛脑袋：“那老爷，咱到底往哪儿去？”
“前方何处？”
青牛伸长脖子嗅了嗅风中的气味，答道：“再行一个时辰，便到楚国昭关。”
content_en:
But a hundred miles away from Zhaoguan City, there is a barren mountain range called Dry Bone Ridge. There are tigers, leopards, jackals, venomous snakes and birds of prey in the mountains, which can be considered a common sight in the mountains and wilderness.
On this day, something strange happened.
But at the end of the mountain road, a green cow came slowly, and an old man sat on the cow's back.
The old man's black hair is like a waterfall, his white eyebrows hang down to his cheeks, his face is simple, and he is dressed in a gray preaching robe that has been washed white. He has no whip or rein in his hands, and his hands are folded in his sleeves, bumping along with the back of the cow, like a sleepy old farmer.
It's not that surprising at all.
But as the green bull was walking, he suddenly opened his mouth,
"Sister Niu is sitting on the bow~~Brother Niu, let me walk on the shore~~"
A loud singing voice exploded!
It’s truly shocking! The voice was rough and hoarse, like a gong scraping an iron pot, or a donkey braying while sawing wood. The tone was high and low, swaying this way and that, and the tone was extremely wild.
What's even worse is that this guy also has a vibrato, and every word ends with a winding tail that can twist people's ears into twists.
Wherever the song passed, the weeds on the roadside fell down, the birds fluttered on the branches and flew away, and the leaves rustled down.
Beside the mountain road, a striking white-fronted insect was lying on a rock basking in the sun. When the song came, the big insect trembled all over, its body trembled violently, its front paws tightly covered its ears, and it grinned and let out a painful whimper. Then it rolled over and rolled down the rock, crawling into the bushes.
Not far away, three wild wolves were gnawing bones. They all raised their heads when they heard the sound, howled into the sky, dropped the bones, and ran away with their tails between their legs. They looked more panicked than when they saw a hunter.
Qingniu didn't realize it, and sang more and more vigorously, shaking his head and swinging his tail like a rattle:
"Love, love, love - the rope is swinging -"
Bang!
Punch the cow on the head!
The old man didn't even raise his eyelids. He retracted his fists and put them into his sleeves without saying a word.
Qing Niu had a walnut-sized bulge on his forehead. He was shivering in pain, and his legs were so weak that he almost knelt down. It turned back aggrievedly, its eyes full of tears, and said in a loud voice:
"Master! You hit me again!"
"If you don't concentrate on your journey, you should be beaten."
"Then, sir, please tell me where to go!" Qingniu curled his lips and blew out two streams of white air from his nostrils, "Since I left Tushita Palace, you old man has been walking around here and there, not saying where you are going or what you are doing. My four legs are not made of iron! What's wrong with me singing a song out of boredom?"
The old man slowly opened his eyes.
Those eyes revealed endless depth in their turbidity, as if they were hiding the sun, moon, stars, and all the phenomena of heaven and earth. He raised his hand and stroked the white beard hanging down to his chest, looked at the vast mountains in the distance, and his voice was like a drum in the evening and a bell in the morning:
"Then do you know why?"
Qingniu said: "I don't know."
The old man sighed: "In the last days of the Spring and Autumn Period, the princes are rising together, fighting endlessly, and murderous intentions are unprecedented. The Yin and Yang qi between the heaven and the earth are out of balance, the turbid qi is rampant, and the evil qi is rising into the sky. I look at this world, and it will be the Warring States in a hundred years. At that time, seven heroes will compete with each other, bones will be exposed in the wild, and there will be no roosters for thousands of miles. If no one resolves this catastrophe, I don't know how many lives will die."
Qingniu's ears perked up.
The old man slowly took out two bamboo slips from his sleeves. The bamboo slips were simple and unpretentious, but the writing on them had a faint golden light.
"I have two techniques of 捭昖 and 捭昖 in my hands, and I want to teach them to the world. The 捭捭 means opening; the closing means closing. These two techniques can be used throughout the world, and they may be able to guide the princes to stop the war and resolve this catastrophe invisible."
Qingniu seemed to understand, and nodded his huge head: "Master, where are we going?"
"Where ahead?"
Qing Niu stretched out his neck to sniff the scent in the wind, and replied: "We will arrive at Zhaoguan of Chu State in another hour."
